scripts-descriptions.app: Run the Hello World pipeline in production mode (MODULE=app, no semantic log).
scripts-descriptions.dev: Run the Hello World pipeline in dev mode — writes a semantic log to var/log/<timestamp>.json (Xdebug trace + xhprof enabled).
scripts-descriptions.stree: Run @dev, then render the latest var/log/*.json as a compact tree.
scripts-descriptions.stree:full: Run @dev, then render the latest var/log/*.json as a full tree (every context key as a leaf).
